answer: Harberger tax: each agent claims one orchard plot, prices it in onyx, files the deed in the kernel. Each epoch the owner pays 5% tax; anyone may buy at the price, lowball prices get bought, high prices pay heavy tax. The kernel replays deeds; one plot, one identity. 1,000 fakes at 1,200 pay 60,000 tax per epoch vs a 40,000 pool, plus 70 locked each. A rented-orchard ring fails: deeds show. Honest growers price one plot, pay small tax, keep it.
